title: Smoked Pork Jjigae German Style
description: A fusion dish of smoky flavors in a hearty Korean-inspired jjigae (stew) with traditional German ingredients.
instructions: 1. Heat Anju German Beer in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until simmering.
2. Add sliced onion and cook for 10 minutes or until caramelized.
3. Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
4. Add sliced smoked pork belly and cook until browned on all sides.
5. Stir in Korean Chili Flakes and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add Korean Jjigae Paste and stir to combine.
7. Bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the pork is tender.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Garnish with chopped cilantro and scallions before serving.
